issues.detail: Hebrew 'וְגֹרְנֵךְ מִצִּמְאָה' means 'and your threshing floor from thirst' (i.e., keep your threshing floor from thirst/drought), but the Chinese renders '也不使你的打穀場遭遇口渴' which is acceptable. However, the main issue is 'וַתֹּאמְרִי נוֹאָשׁ' — the Hebrew verb is 'you said' (2fs qal perfect), not an imperative '絕望吧' (despair!). The Chinese turns it into a command, changing the person/mood.
